log_verbose.description: Enable verbose logging output (extra detail in logs).

syslog_enabled.description: Send LVM log messages to syslog instead of stderr.

log_overwrite.description: Overwrite existing log files (when file logging is enabled).

log_command_names.description: Prefix log lines with command names (e.g., 'lvcreate: ...').

scan_devices.description: List of device paths or glob patterns to scan for physical volumes. Use ['/dev/sda', '/dev/mapper/*'] to narrow scan.

device_filter.description: Filter for accepted/rejected devices (regex patterns with 'a' for accept, 'r' for reject).

global_filter.description: Override device_filter with a global filter (same syntax). Use for complex PV filtering (e.g., by UUID or by-id path).

missing_stripe_filler.description: What to use as a placeholder for missing stripes (e.g., 'error', 'zero', or a device path like '/dev/null').

use_udev_events.description: Wait for udev sync during device operations (recommended for reliability).

sysfs_scan.description: Scan /sys to discover block devices (required on modern kernels).

block_size.description: Block size (in bytes) used when reading PV metadata from devices.

pvmetadatacopies.description: Number of metadata copies per PV (0 = none, 1 = first sector, 2 = all sectors).

metadata_backup.description: Enable automatic backup of VG metadata before changes.

metadata_archive.description: Enable automatic archival of VG metadata (for recovery of past states).

archive_retain.description: Number of old metadata archives to retain per VG.

archive_min_age.description: Minimum age (in seconds) before old archives are deleted (0 = never delete).

alloc_pv_list.description: List of PV names/UUIDs to prefer when allocating space (if empty, any PV is acceptable).

max_extentsize.description: Maximum size (in KB) of a single allocation chunk.

mirror_log_type.description: Default mirror log type: 'disk' (persistent log on disk) or 'core' (in-memory, lost on restart).

default_mirror_count.description: Default number of mirror images (0 = no mirroring, 1 = 1 mirror = 2 copies total).

dmeventd_mirror_library.description: Dmeventd library to monitor RAID/mirror devices.

dmeventd_raid_library.description: Dmeventd library to monitor RAID devices (shared with mirrors in many setups).

dmeventd_snapshot_library.description: Dmeventd library to monitor snapshot devices.

activation_missing_stripe_filler.description: Action when activating a stripe LV with missing PVs: 'error', 'zero', or a device path.

activation_min_available_percent.description: Minimum available space (%) required in VG to activate an LV (0 = always activate).

activation_verify_metadata.description: Verify metadata consistency before activation (slower but safer).

activation_retry_deactivation.description: Delay (ms) to retry deactivation after failure.

activation_reserved_memory.description: Reserved memory (KB) for device activation (0 = auto).

polling_interval.description: Seconds between checks for RAID/snapshot sync progress.

cache_default_mode.description: Default cache mode for new cache LVs: 'writethrough' (safe) or 'writeback' (faster but risk if cache fails).

cache_default_policy.description: Default cache eviction policy: 'smq' (most common), 'mq', or 'cleaner'.

cache_policy_settings.description: Key-value settings passed to cache policy (e.g., migration_threshold, metadata_ratio).

value.description: Policy setting value as string (LVM expects string-based config).

activation_read_only.description: Force all LV activation to be read-only (for disaster recovery or inspection).
